webhooks.branches_hint: One prefix per line. Empty means the whole forest. Only applies to events that name a node.
webhooks.delete_body: Nothing more will be sent to {url}. To stop delivery without losing the subscription, turn it off instead.
webhooks.delete_sub: Its secret and its delivery log go with it.
webhooks.delivery_rules: Up to {attempts} attempts with a growing wait, {timeout}s each. After {suspend} failed deliveries in a row a webhook is suspended.
webhooks.empty_hint: A webhook is how this forest starts a conversation instead of waiting to be asked.
webhooks.enabled_hint: Turn off to stop delivery without losing the subscription or the secret.
webhooks.event.access.denied: a call was refused for lack of a capability
webhooks.event.answer.failed: an answer could not be produced
webhooks.event.branch.created: the new node was a branch
webhooks.event.canopy.built: the vector index was built or refreshed
webhooks.event.grant.changed: a grant on this forest was written or revoked
webhooks.event.ingest.document.failed: one document inside a batch failed
webhooks.event.ingest.failed: a batch ended in an error
webhooks.event.model.bound: a model role was bound or unbound here
webhooks.event.pair.issued: a password was paired into a key
webhooks.event.provider.changed: a provider was created, edited or removed
webhooks.events_sub: What is worth a POST. Pick as many as you need — one act may fire more than one name.
webhooks.group.answer_hint: Usage and cost. The question and the reply never travel.
webhooks.group.config_hint: Providers and forests — the things shared by everything.
webhooks.group.content_hint: Something was planted, extended or written.
webhooks.group.ingest_hint: A batch started, finished, failed — or one document did.
webhooks.group.maintenance_hint: Snapshots, the vector index, the catalog repair.
webhooks.headers_hint: Up to {n}. Values are write-only: they are sent, never shown again. The X-MonkeyLLM-* set belongs to the delivery.
webhooks.label: Name
webhooks.label_hint: For you, in this list. It never travels in the payload.
webhooks.log_empty_hint: Send a test, or wait for one of the subscribed events.
webhooks.log_sub: One row per attempt, newest first
webhooks.metadata: Include the title and the summary
webhooks.metadata_hint: Off by default. Bodies, snippets, answers, SQL and dataset rows never travel, in any mode.
webhooks.metadata_note: A delivery leaves this Station's authority behind: whoever holds the URL reads it, with no scope, and revoking a grant later reaches none of it. Leave this off and the receiver comes back through the API with its own key to read what it may.
webhooks.narrowing_sub: Narrow the events down, and decide how much each one says.
webhooks.needs_admin: This console needs the 'admin' capability on this forest.
webhooks.pick_one: Pick at least one event — a webhook with none would never fire.
webhooks.preview_empty: Pick an event and its body appears here.
webhooks.preview_note: Identity and shape: ids, types, counts, states, commits. Deduplicate by `id` — a retry sends these exact bytes again.
webhooks.preview_sub: The real shape, not a description of it
webhooks.queue: {pending} waiting to go out · {dropped} dropped because the queue was full
webhooks.recipe.automation_hint: Start an n8n, Make or Zapier flow that reads the node back through the API.
webhooks.recipe.chat_hint: Post to Slack, Teams or Discord when a document lands or an ingest fails.
webhooks.recipe.service_hint: Reindex a search, refresh a cache, page somebody when the answer model starts refusing.
webhooks.scope_deployment_hint: Hears every forest, plus the events that belong to none — sign-ins, keys, providers. Only a principal who administers every forest may hold one.
webhooks.scope_forest_hint: Hears this forest's events only. Managed by anyone who administers it.
webhooks.secret_once: This is shown once. It is not stored anywhere you can read it back — if you lose it, make a new one.
webhooks.secret_use: Your endpoint uses it to check X-MonkeyLLM-Signature on every request, so it can tell a real delivery from anybody who found the URL.
webhooks.sub: What this forest tells your other tools, and when
webhooks.suspended_authority_hint: The principal this webhook belongs to no longer has the authority it needs. Restore that access, or save this webhook to take it over yourself.
webhooks.suspended_failing_hint: The destination failed too many times in a row and the Station stopped trying. Fix the address and save — saving resumes it.
webhooks.test_note: A test sends `webhook.test`, which nothing can subscribe to. It says whether the address answers — not whether the subscription is healthy.
webhooks.test_unreachable: The address could not be reached
webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.url_hint: An https address that accepts a POST. The Station resolves the host and refuses private addresses unless the deployment allows them.
webhooks.verify_sub: Check every request before you trust it
webhooks.where_sub: Where the notification goes, and whether it is running
